name: WALK OR DIE
desc:
Welcome to FINAL WARNING:

👑 You and up to 40 others are selected to participate in a government sponsored walking competition. No finish line, no breaks, only one winner.

🤝 Will you choose companionship or competition?

👟 Play as a WALKER: Manage hunger & thirst, keep above the minimum speed of 3.0 to survive, exceed 3 warnings and you're out. 💀

🪖 Play as a SOLDIER: Enforce the rules and collect bounties. 

🛑 Early access - more features coming soon! 🛑
Inspired by Stephen King's The Long Walk.
(originally named WALK OR DIE.)
